title: Facebook Ad Adromeda Update Strategy 🚀
transcript: Here's why everyone is wrong about the meta Adromeda update. Old meta you could test five hooks on the same creative and call it a day. That used to work, but Adromeda changed everything. Now you need at least 10 to 30 completely unique ads. Totally different visuals, angles, craters, formats. Not hook variations, not headline tweaks. Full blown unique ads. Adometer rewards creative diversity, not creative iterations anymore. The brand scaling right now aren't testing hooks. They're testing hybrid U G C, product demos, stat based ads, problem solution comparisons, animations, photo ads and everything in between. Comment update and I'll show you the full strategy that is working right now.
